# Preferred Summary

Summary: Reeder McCreary, LLP is a full service business litigation firm based in Los Angeles, California (11766 Wilshire Blvd, Suite 1470, Los Angeles, CA 90025). The firm emphasizes trials and commercial litigation, corporate counsel, and strategic business legal services for clients from entrepreneurs to large international corporations. Published practice areas on this site are: Trials and Commercial Litigation; Real Estate; Corporate; Franchise and Dealership; Entertainment; Sports; Employment; Intellectual Property; White Collar Crime / Investigations. The firm also highlights general counsel work including M&A, financings, investigations, franchising, real estate transactions, trademarks, compliance, and related matters as described on the About page.
